description: Lists Matter smart home products in MatterCatalog's catalog by category, platform, network and brand, with one line of facts each: the product page's certification answer (CSA certificate and date), network and whether it needs a Thread border router, the platforms its page lists, and the stores its page links (names only, no prices). By default only products sold in the US with a verified store link and a CSA certificate for the exact model. Includes the matching MatterCatalog buying guide's picks where one exists. Each product links to its MatterCatalog page.

certified_only.description: true (default): only products with a CSA certificate for the exact model.

network.description: Matter network. Thread devices need a Thread border router; Wi-Fi and Ethernet do not.

sold_in_us.description: true (default): only products sold in the US with a verified US store link; false adds records sold outside the US and reference records.

works_with.description: Platform the product page lists (from the maker's own pages). Home Assistant is not recorded per product; with it, the answer explains how Home Assistant uses Matter and lists products by the other filters.

name: find_matter_devices
title: Find Matter devices
